book.name: Luku
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ LUKU U YORUA

content: Yesu u tɑbu sunɔ ɡoon yoo
bɛkiɑ
Ye Yesu u ɡɑri yi kpuro tɔmbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u kpɑ, u dɑ Kɑpenɑmuɔ.
Tɑbu sunɔ ɡoo wɑ̃ɑ mi u yoo mɔ, wi u kĩ ɡem ɡem. Yoo wiyɑ u bɑrɔ sere u wɑsikirɑ.
Ye tɔnwero wi, u Yesun lɑbɑɑri nuɑ, yeyɑ u nùn Yuubɑn ɡuro ɡurobu ɡɑbu ɡɔriɑ bu nùn suuru kɑnɑ u nɑ u win yoo bɛkiɑ.
Ye bɑ turɑ Yesun mi bɑ nùn suuru kɑnɑ ɡem ɡem bɑ nɛɛ, n turɑ ɑ durɔ wi ye kuɑ
domi u bɛsɛn bweseru kĩ. Wiyɑ mɑɑ sun bɛsɛn mɛnnɔ yeru bɑniɑ.
Mɑ Yesu u kɑ bu swɑɑ wɔri. Ye u yɛnu ɡe turuku kuɑ yerɑ tɑbu sunɔ wi, u win bɔrɔbɑ ɡɔrɑ bu Yesu sɔ̃ u ku tii ɡɔnɡɛrɛ ko, domi wi kun be turɑ u du win yɛnuɔ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ u ǹ tii ɡɑrisi ɡoo wi u koo kɑ tii dɑ Yesun mi. Adɑmɑ u be ɡesi ɡɑri ɡeruo, win yoo u koo bɛkurɑ.
Domi wi, u ɡɑbu wiru kpĩiyɛ, u mɑɑ tɑbu kowobu mɔ be u kpɑre. Ù n turo sɔ̃ɔwɑ u doo, u rɑ n dɔɔwɑ. Ù n mɑɑ ben ɡoo sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɑ, u rɑ n sisiwɑ. Ù n win yoo sɔ̃ɔwɑ u yeni koowo, u rɑ n mɑɑ ye mɔ̀wɑ.
Ye Yesu u ɡɑri yi nuɑ biti yɑ nùn mwɑ, mɑ u sĩirɑ u tɔmbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ be bɑ nùn swĩi u nɛɛ, nɑ ǹ ɡinɑ nɑɑnɛ doke bɑkɑ binin bweseru wɑɑre, bɑɑ Isirelibɑ sɔɔ.
Ye ɡɔro be, bɑ ɡɔsirɑ yɛnuɔ bɑ deemɑ yoo wi, u bwɑ̃ɑ dorɑ.
Yesu u ɡɔmini ɡoon bii seesiɑ
Yen sisiru Yesu dɑ wuu ɡɑɡun mi, ɡe bɑ rɑ soku Nɑyini. Win bwɑ̃ɑbu kɑ mɑɑ tɔn wɔru ɡunɑ nùn swĩi.
Sɑɑ ye u wuu ɡen ɡbɑ̃rɑrun kɔnnɔ turuku kuɑ, u wɑ bɑ ɑluwɑɑsi ɡoon ɡoru sɔɔwɑ bɑ kɑ yɑriɔ bu sike. U sɑ̃ɑwɑ win mɛron bii teere te u mɔ. Win mɛro mɑɑ, ɡɔminiwɑ. Wuuɡibu dɑbirɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ wi.
Ye Yinni u kurɔ wi wɑ win wɔnwɔndɑ nùn mwɑ, mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ku swĩ.
Yerɑ u susi u ɡoo ten kpɑkororu bɑbɑ. Be bɑ tu sɔɔwɑ bɑ yɔ̃rɑ. Mɑ u nɛɛ, ɑluwɑɑsi wunɛ, nɑ nun sɔ̃ɔmɔ, ɑ seewo.
Mɑ ɡoo te, tɑ seewɑ tɑ sinɑ tɑ ɡɑri ɡerumɔ. Mɑ Yesu nùn win mɛro wesiɑ.
Bɛrum be kpuro mwɑ, mɑ bɑ Gusunɔ siɑrɑmɔ bɑ ɡerumɔ bɑ mɔ̀, Gusunɔn sɔmɔ dɑmɡiiwɑ u bu kuremɑ. Gusunɔwɑ u win tɔmbu nɑɑwɑ.
Yesun lɑbɑɑri ye, yɑ yɑbi Yudeɑ kpuro sɔɔ kɑ mɑɑ yen beri kpuro.
Yohɑnu Bɑtɛmu kowon
ɡɔrobu
Yohɑnun bwɑ̃ɑbɑ nùn ye kpuron lɑbɑɑri sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Mɑ u win bwɑ̃ɑ ben yiru sokɑ,
u bu ɡɔrɑ Yesun mi bu nùn bikiɑ, wiyɑ wi u sisi? Nɡe bɑ n kpɑo mɑrɑ.
Ye durɔ be, bɑ turɑ win mi, bɑ nɛɛ, Yohɑnu Bɑtɛmu kowowɑ sun ɡɔrimɑ wunɛn mi su bikiɑ, wunɑ wi u sisi? Nɡe sɑ n kpɑo mɑrɑ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, u tɔn dɑbirun bɑrɑnu kɑ ben ɑlebu bɛkiɑ, mɑ u ben wɛrɛkunu ɡirɑ, u mɑɑ wɔ̃ko dɑbinu yɑm wɑɑsiɑ.

Mɑ u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, i doo i Yohɑnu tusiɑ ye i wɑ kɑ ye i nuɑ. Wɔ̃kobɑ yɑm wɑɑmɔ, yɛmɔbɑ sĩimɔ, be bɑ bɑrɑ disiɡiru bɑrɔ bɑ bɛkurɑmɔ bɑ dɛɛrɑmɔ, sosobu bɑ ɡɑri nɔɔmɔ, bɑ ɡɔribu seeyɑmɔ, mɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑrobu Lɑbɑɑri ɡeɑn wɑɑsu mɔ̀.
Doo nɔɔruɡiiwɑ bɑɑwure wìn nɑɑnɛ yɑ yɔ̃ dim dim nɛ sɔɔ.
Ye Yohɑnun ɡɔrobɑ sĩɑ, mɑ u tɔn dɑbinu Yohɑnun ɡɑri sɔ̃ɔbu wɔri. U bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ i mɛɛrim dɑ ɡbɑburɔ. Yɑkɔ ɡe woo ɡɑ toorimɔ?
Durɔ wi u yɑ̃ɑ bɛɛrɛɡinu sebuɑ? Wee, be bɑ yɑ̃ɑ ɡobiɡinu sebuɑ mɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑru dimɔ dukiɑ sɔɔ, beyɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ sinɑ kpɑɑnɔ.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, mbɑ i mɛɛrim dɑ. Gusunɔn sɔmɔ ɡoo? Mɛyɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ yɛ̃ro mɑm Gusunɔn sɔmɔ kere mi n tomɑ.
Domi Yohɑnu wiyɑ wìn ɡɑri bɑ yoruɑ bɑ nɛɛ,

content.text: “N wee, nɑ nɛn ɡɔro ɡɔrɑ wunɛn wuswɑɑɔ wi u koo nun ɡbiiyɑ u wunɛn swɑɑ sɔmɛ.”

content: Nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ mɑ be tɔn kurɔbɑ mɑrɑ sɔɔ, ɡoo kun Yohɑnu kere, ɑdɑmɑ wi u yɑ̃kɑbu bo Gusunɔn bɑndu sɔɔ, u Yohɑnu kere.
Ye bɑ ye nuɑ, tɔmbu kpuro kɑ ɡbere mwɑɔbu sɑnnu bɑ Gusunɔ ɡem wɛ̃, domi beyɑ Yohɑnu u rɑɑ bɑtɛmu kuɑ.
Adɑmɑ Fɑlisibɑ kɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robu bɑ ǹ dɑɑ wure Yohɑnu u bu bɑtɛmu ko. Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ kɑ yinɑ ye Gusunɔ u ɡɔ̃ru doke u bu kuɑ.
Mɑ Yinni u bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ kon kɑ tɛ̃n tɔmbu weesinɑ. Mbɑ bɑ kɑ weenɛ.
Bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe bibu be bɑ sɔ̃ yɑburɔ, bɑ sokunɑmɔ bɑ mɔ̀, sɑ bɛɛ ɡuuru soowɑ mɑ i ǹ yɑwɑ. Sɑ bɛɛ ɡɔɔ womu kuɑ, i ǹ mɑɑ swĩ.
Domi Yohɑnu Bɑtɛmu kowo u nɑ, u ǹ dĩɑnu dimɔ, u ǹ mɑɑ tɑm nɔrumɔ, mɑ i nɛɛ, u wɛrɛkunu mɔ.
Tɔnun Bii u nɑ, u dimɔ u nɔrumɔ, mɑ i ɡerumɔ u sɑ̃ɑ dim kĩro kɑ tɑm nɔro, ɡbere mwɑɔbu kɑ kɔ̃sɑn kowobun bɔrɔ.
Kɑ mɛ, Gusunɔn bwisi yi rɑ tii sɔ̃ɔsi bwisi ɡee be bɑ yi wurɑn mi.
Yesu dimɔ Fɑlisi ɡoon yɛnuɔ
Fɑlisi ɡoo wi bɑ mɔ̀ Simɔɔ u Yesu dim sokɑ. Mɑ Yesu u duɑ win dirɔ u sinɑ u kɑ di.
Kurɔ tɑnɔ ɡoo wɑ̃ɑ wuu mi. Ye u nuɑ mɑ Yesu u dimɔ Fɑlisi win yɛnuɔ, yerɑ u kɑ too burɑru nɑ te tɑ turɑre yibɑ.
U yɔ̃rɑ Yesun biruɔ win nɑɑsu ɡiɑ u sumɔ. Mɑ win yĩresu nɑɑ si wɑɑyɑ, mɑ u su sunkumɔ kɑ win seri, u su sɔ̃sumɔ, mɑ u su turɑre ye wisi.
Fɑlisi wi u Yesu dim sokɑ, ye u wɑ mɛ, u ɡeruɑ win ɡɔ̃ruɔ u nɛɛ, durɔ wi, ù n Gusunɔn sɔmɔn nɑ, u ko n yɛ̃ kurɔ weren bweserɑ wi u nùn bɑbɑmɔ, domi kurɔ tɑnɔwɑ.
Mɑ Yesu u nɛɛ, Simɔɔ, nɑ ɡɑri ɡɛɛ mɔ yi kon nun sɔ̃. Mɑ Simɔɔ u nɛɛ, yinni, ɑ ɡeruo.
Mɑ Yesu u nɛɛ, durɔ ɡoo wɑ̃ɑ wìn dibu tɔmbu yiru bɑ nɛni. Turo nɛni sii ɡeesun ɡobi nɛɛrɑ wunɔbu (500), turo mɑɑ weerɑɑkuru.
Ye bɑ ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu wɑ bu kɔsiɑ, mɑ u be yiru kpuro suuru kuɑ. Tɛ̃ be yiru ye sɔɔ, wɑrɑ koo nùn kĩɑ n kere.
Simɔɔ u nɛɛ, nɑ tɑmɑɑ wi bɑ suuru kuɑ n kere. Mɑ Yesu u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɡemɑ ɑ ɡeruɑ.

Yerɑ u sĩirɑ kurɔ win mi ɡiɑ mɑ u Simɔɔ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ kurɔ wi wɑ? Ye nɑ duɑ wunɛn yɛnuɔ ɑ ǹ mɑn nim kɑ̃ n kɑ nɛn kɔ̃ri kpɑkiɑ, ɑdɑmɑ kurɔ wini u nɛn nɑɑsu wɑɑyɑ kɑ win yĩresu, mɑ u su sunkɑ kɑ win seri.
A ǹ mɑn tɔburɑ kɑ sɔ̃subu, ɑdɑmɑ kurɔ wini, mìn di nɑ duɑ, u ǹ nɛn nɑɑsu sɔ̃sum deri.
A ǹ ɡum wisi nɛn wiru wɔllɔ, ɑdɑmɑ kurɔ wini u turɑre wisi nɛn nɑɑsɔ.
Yen sɔ̃, nɑ nun sɔ̃ɔmɔ mɑ kurɔ win durum bɑkɑ ye, bɑ nùn ye suuru kuɑ. Yeyɑ n derɑ win kĩrɑ kpɛ̃ɑ. Adɑmɑ wi bɑ fiiko suuru kuɑ, u rɑ n kĩwɑ fiiko.
Mɑ u kurɔ wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɑ nun wunɛn durum suuru kuɑ.
Be bɑ sɔ̃ bɑ dimɔ kɑ wi, bɑ bikiɑnɑmɔ, wɑrɑ wini wi bɑɑ tɔmbun durum u mɑm suuru mɔ̀.
Mɑ u kurɔ wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wunɛn nɑɑnɛ dokebu nun fɑɑbɑ kuɑ. A doo kɑ ɑlɑfiɑ.
